subject: Apply the look of Kodak Vision3 5219 500T motion picture film stock. See .rundeer/luts/kodak_vision3_5219.md for the full LUT specification. Rich dense shadows with a warm chocolate-brown base, bright saturated midtones with natural skin tones, gentle highlight roll-off that avoids clipping. Introduce subtle silver halide grain scaled for 35mm 2K scan. Colors should feel organic, slightly warm, with cinematic depth and the characteristic tungsten-balanced orange mask of the film base. Preserve all composition, lighting, and subject identity.
